  3b. energy loss via the van Aswegen et al. body-volume-loss models (maternal investment; updated)

  Maternal daily body-volume loss (van Aswegen et al. 2025a).
  Each female's daily loss rate (her body-volume ~ day-of-year slope, from
  repeated within-season measurements) is regressed on maternal total length:
    BV_Slope ~ TL  ->  E[daily loss | TL] = 0.056197 - 0.012621 * TL  (HI only)
  Per Monte Carlo draw we sample the regression coefficient uncertainty
  (intercept/slope SEs) and add among-individual variation from the regression
  residual SD (0.008191). Model summary below.

linear model on the slope of the body volume change per day for mothers across lengths:

Call:
lm(formula = BV_Slope ~ TL * Region, data = repeats)

Residuals:
       Min         1Q     Median         3Q        Max 
-0.0271250 -0.0050062  0.0001685  0.0053220  0.0209050 

Coefficients:
             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
(Intercept)  0.056197   0.014901   3.771 0.000245 ***
TL          -0.012621   0.001159 -10.891  < 2e-16 ***
RegionAK     0.061407   0.036629   1.676 0.096030 .  
TL:RegionAK  0.004861   0.002801   1.735 0.085007 .  
---
Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

Residual standard error: 0.008191 on 131 degrees of freedom
Multiple R-squared:  0.9662,	Adjusted R-squared:  0.9654 
F-statistic:  1247 on 3 and 131 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16
```{r}
# Loss functions live in energetics_functions.R:
#   predict_daily_bv_loss()      - daily BV loss (m3/day): regression coeff SEs + residual SD (0.008191)
#   predict_mother_energy_loss() - converts BV loss to energy (blubber & energy density)


# verify: expected daily loss for focal lengths (m3/day, should be negative)
# 10m: 0.056197 - 0.012621*10 = -0.070; 12m: -0.095; 14m: -0.121
test_rates <- sapply(c(10, 12, 14), function(L)
  mean(predict_daily_bv_loss(L, n = 500)))
cat("Mean daily BV loss (m3/day) at 10, 12, 14 m:", round(test_rates, 3), "\n")

# verify total energy tank over 100-day stay
test_energy <- predict_mother_energy_loss(seq(10, 15, by = 0.5), n = 500)
print(test_energy)

mother_lengths <- seq(10, 15, by = 0.1)
mother_bc_loss <- predict_mother_energy_loss(mother_lengths, n = 500)
```

Christiansen 2022 baleen whale blubber energy density uncertainty
```{r}
#WITH ERROR AROUND ENERGY DENSITY###########
# draw energy density ONCE and pass it in
set.seed(42)
n <- 5000
lipid_pct   <- pmin(pmax(rnorm(n, 62.6, 14.8), 19.2), 81.3)
protein_pct <- pmin(pmax(23.0 - 0.212 * lipid_pct, 3.5), 20.4)
E_blubber_shared <- (lipid_pct / 100 * 39539) + (protein_pct / 100 * 23640)

# updated function that accepts pre-drawn energy density

mother_lengths  <- unique(results$MotherLength)
mother_bc_loss  <- predict_mother_energy_loss_v2(
  mother_lengths, E_blubber_shared, n = n
)

# --- decompose uncertainty sources for a 14 m mother ---
set.seed(123)
n <- 5000
L <- 14

# volume loss draws only (fix E_blubber at mean)
bv_loss_draws <- predict_daily_bv_loss(L, n)
daily_fixed_E <- (abs(bv_loss_draws) * 986 * 26755) / 1000
cat("Uncertainty from volume loss rate only:\n")
cat("  mean:", round(mean(daily_fixed_E)),
    "2.5%:", round(quantile(daily_fixed_E, 0.025)),
    "97.5%:", round(quantile(daily_fixed_E, 0.975)), "MJ/day\n\n")

# energy density draws only (fix BV loss at mean for 14 m)
mean_bv_loss <- abs(0.056197 - 0.012621 * 14)  # ~ 0.1205 m3/day
lipid_pct    <- pmin(pmax(rnorm(n, 62.6, 14.8), 19.2), 81.3)
protein_pct  <- pmin(pmax(23.0 - 0.212 * lipid_pct, 3.5), 20.4)
E_draws      <- (lipid_pct / 100 * 39539) + (protein_pct / 100 * 23640)
daily_fixed_BV <- (mean_bv_loss * 986 * E_draws) / 1000
cat("Uncertainty from energy density only:\n")
cat("  mean:", round(mean(daily_fixed_BV)),
    "2.5%:", round(quantile(daily_fixed_BV, 0.025)),
    "97.5%:", round(quantile(daily_fixed_BV, 0.975)), "MJ/day\n\n")

# both combined
lipid_pct2   <- pmin(pmax(rnorm(n, 62.6, 14.8), 19.2), 81.3)
protein_pct2 <- pmin(pmax(23.0 - 0.212 * lipid_pct2, 3.5), 20.4)
E_draws2     <- (lipid_pct2 / 100 * 39539) + (protein_pct2 / 100 * 23640)
daily_both   <- (abs(bv_loss_draws) * 986 * E_draws2) / 1000
cat("Combined uncertainty:\n")
cat("  mean:", round(mean(daily_both)),
    "2.5%:", round(quantile(daily_both, 0.025)),
    "97.5%:", round(quantile(daily_both, 0.975)), "MJ/day\n")
```

  3c. maternal energy transfer (loss-expenditure)
```{r}
# --- predict BC-based energy loss for all mother lengths in results ---
mother_lengths <- unique(results$MotherLength)

mother_bc_loss <- predict_mother_energy_loss(mother_lengths, n = 500)

# --- join to simulation results and estimate lactation cost ---
# note: results has multiple rows per MotherLength (varying p_rest and calf age)
# BC loss is independent of those - it's the observed total loss from the animal

lactation_estimates <- results %>%
  left_join(mother_bc_loss, by = "MotherLength") %>%
  mutate(
    
    # --- point estimate ---
    # lactation = total observed BC loss - (loco + BMR)
    lactation_mean = energy_loss_mean_MJ - mom_total_mean,
    
    # --- uncertainty ---
    # BC loss uncertainty and simulation uncertainty are independent
    # so variances add: SD_combined = sqrt(SD_bc^2 + SD_sim^2)
    # approximate simulation SD from CI assuming normality: SD ~ (upr - lwr) / (2 * 1.96)
    sd_bc  = (energy_loss_upr_MJ - energy_loss_lwr_MJ) / (2 * 1.96),
    sd_sim = (mom_total_upr - mom_total_lwr)            / (2 * 1.96),
    sd_lac = sqrt(sd_bc^2 + sd_sim^2),
    
    lactation_lwr = lactation_mean - 1.96 * sd_lac,
    lactation_upr = lactation_mean + 1.96 * sd_lac
    
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sd_bc, -sd_sim, -sd_lac)

lactation_estimates %>%
  filter(lactation_mean > 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(MotherLength, p_rest, mom_total_mean, 
                energy_loss_mean_MJ, lactation_mean) %>%
  summary()

  summarise(

    pct_negative   = mean(lactation_lwr < 0) * 100,
    min_lwr        = min(lactation_lwr),
    .by = MotherLength
  ) %>%

write.csv(lactation_estimates, 
          file.path(out_dir, "lactation_estimates.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(lactation_estimates, file.path(rds_dir, "lactation_estimates.rds"))
```
  

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


# --- trend line: p_rest = 0.4 (empirical mean) ---
lactation_summary <- lactation_estimates %>%
  filter(p_rest == 0.4, Age == 50) %>%
  mutate(
    MotherMass_kg = predict_mother_mass(MotherLength),
    pct_to_calf   = (lactation_mean / energy_loss_mean_MJ) * 100,
    lac_per_kg    = lactation_mean / MotherMass_kg
  )

# --- sensitivity band: range across all simulated p_rest values (0.2-0.8) ---
lac_band <- lactation_estimates %>%
  filter(Age == 50) %>%
  mutate(
    MotherMass_kg = predict_mother_mass(MotherLength),
    pct_to_calf   = (lactation_mean / energy_loss_mean_MJ) * 100,
    lac_per_kg    = lactation_mean / MotherMass_kg
  ) %>%
  group_by(MotherLength) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_min = min(pct_to_calf),
    pct_max = max(pct_to_calf),
    kg_min  = min(lac_per_kg),
    kg_max  = max(lac_per_kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("pct_to_calf range (p_rest=0.4):", range(lactation_summary$pct_to_calf),  "\n")
cat("lac_per_kg range  (p_rest=0.4):", range(lactation_summary$lac_per_kg),   "\n")
cat("p_rest band width (pct):", round(mean(lac_band$pct_max - lac_band$pct_min), 1), "percentage points\n")

# Build the band symmetrically around the p_rest=0.4 trend to avoid
# off-centering from MC noise (n=200/row). Half-width = half the total
# p_rest range, smoothed with loess to remove residual MC noise.

lac_band <- lac_band %>%
  left_join(
    lactation_summary %>% dplyr::select(MotherLength, pct_to_calf, lac_per_kg),
    by = "MotherLength"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_center    = smooth_vec(MotherLength, pct_to_calf),
    kg_center     = smooth_vec(MotherLength, lac_per_kg),
    pct_halfwidth = smooth_vec(MotherLength, (pct_max - pct_min) / 2),
    kg_halfwidth  = smooth_vec(MotherLength, (kg_max  - kg_min)  / 2),
    pct_min = pct_center - pct_halfwidth,
    pct_max = pct_center + pct_halfwidth,
    kg_min  = kg_center  - kg_halfwidth,
    kg_max  = kg_center  + kg_halfwidth
  )
```

```{r}
# Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette
blue_color <- "#0072B2"   # blue
red_color  <- "#D55E00"   # vermillion

y_left_min  <- 35;  y_left_max  <- 70
y_right_min <- 0.02; y_right_max <- 0.12   # was 0.10
scale_factor <- (y_left_max - y_left_min) / (y_right_max - y_right_min)
offset       <- y_left_min - y_right_min * scale_factor

fig3 <- ggplot(lactation_summary, aes(x = MotherLength)) +
  # --- p_rest sensitivity band: % of daily loss ---
  geom_ribbon(
    data = lac_band,
    aes(x = MotherLength, ymin = pct_min, ymax = pct_max),
    fill = blue_color, alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # --- p_rest sensitivity band: mass-specific cost ---
  geom_ribbon(
    data = lac_band,
    aes(x = MotherLength, ymin = to_left(kg_min), ymax = to_left(kg_max)),
    fill = red_color, alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # --- % of daily loss to calf (p_rest = 0.4 trend) ---
  geom_smooth(
    aes(y = pct_to_calf, color = "% of total daily energy loss to calf"),
    method = "loess", span = 0.5, se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  # --- mass-specific lactation cost (p_rest = 0.4 trend) ---
  geom_smooth(
    aes(y = to_left(lac_per_kg), color = "Mass-specific lactation cost"),
    method = "loess", span = 0.5, se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.1, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "% of total daily energy loss to calf",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ to_right(.),
      name   = expression("Mass-specific lactation cost (MJ day"^{-1}*" kg"^{-1}*")"),
      breaks = seq(y_right_min, y_right_max, by = 0.02)
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c(
      "% of total daily energy loss to calf" = blue_color,
      "Mass-specific lactation cost"          = red_color
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Maternal length (m)",
    breaks = seq(10, 15, by = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_left_min, y_left_max)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title           = element_text(size = 13, face = "plain", hjust = 0,
                                        margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title           = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text            = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y.left    = element_text(color = blue_color, size = 12),
    axis.text.y.left     = element_text(color = blue_color),
    axis.title.y.right   = element_text(color = red_color, size = 12),
    axis.text.y.right    = element_text(color = red_color),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin          = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )
```

```{r}
p_rest_show <- c(0.2, 0.4, 0.8)

lac_lines <- lactation_estimates %>%
  filter(Age == 50, p_rest %in% p_rest_show) %>%
  mutate(
    MotherMass_kg = predict_mother_mass(MotherLength),
    pct_to_calf   = (lactation_mean / energy_loss_mean_MJ) * 100,
    lac_per_kg    = lactation_mean / MotherMass_kg
  ) %>%
  group_by(p_rest) %>% arrange(MotherLength) %>%
  mutate(pct_s = smooth_vec(MotherLength, pct_to_calf),
         kg_s  = smooth_vec(MotherLength, lac_per_kg)) %>%
  ungroup()

lines_long <- bind_rows(
  lac_lines %>% transmute(MotherLength, p_rest,
                          outcome = "% of total daily energy loss to calf", y = pct_s),
  lac_lines %>% transmute(MotherLength, p_rest,
                          outcome = "Mass-specific lactation cost",          y = to_left(kg_s))
) %>%
  mutate(emph = p_rest == 0.4)          # emphasize the empirical mean

line_ends <- lines_long %>% group_by(outcome, p_rest) %>%
  slice_max(MotherLength, n = 1) %>% ungroup()

fig3 <- ggplot(lines_long,
               aes(x = MotherLength, y = y,
                   group = interaction(outcome, p_rest), color = outcome)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = emph, linewidth = emph)) +
  geom_text(data = line_ends, aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", p_rest)),
            hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.07, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "dashed", `TRUE` = "solid"), guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.7, `TRUE` = 1.5), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL,
    values = c("% of total daily energy loss to calf" = blue_color,
               "Mass-specific lactation cost"          = red_color)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "% of total daily energy loss to calf",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ to_right(.),
      name   = expression("Mass-specific lactation cost (MJ day"^{-1}*" kg"^{-1}*")"),
      breaks = seq(y_right_min, y_right_max, by = 0.02))) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Maternal length (m)",
    breaks = seq(10, 15, by = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.10))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_left_min, y_left_max)) +
  labs(caption = "Solid = empirical resting proportion (p_rest = 0.4); dashed = p_rest 0.2 and 0.8. Labels give p_rest.") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "top",
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = blue_color, size = 12),
    axis.text.y.left   = element_text(color = blue_color),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = red_color,  size = 12),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = red_color),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin        = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )
```
